## Changelog
### Features
- Include Videos with multiple parts (can be toggled in the plugin settings)
- Auto close the preview popup when starting a new episode (can be toggled in the plugin settings)
- Switch the display mode for the season summary by clicking on the label
### Fixes
- Episode playstate will not be reset anymore on a rewatch
- Spoiler blur will now be updated immediately when triggering the playstate button inside the preview popup
- Video progress bar and season summary will now be live updated
- Season summary will now be displayed at the correct position during season selection
- Empty descriptions will now be shown empty instead of "loading..."
